name: Seed Junky | Permanent Marker
description: Permanent Marker is an indica strain with a lingering, pungent flacor of a soapy funk with a hint of candy and floral gas tones. The potent strain brings out creativity for daytime relaxation, followed by the munchies and the urge to roll up some more.
